# accessflow_sql_review_rule (Resource)

An organization-defined SQL review rule: a condition tree over facts of one parsed statement, and the message a matching statement is reported with. Once saved and enabled it joins the rule catalog — configure it in an `accessflow_sql_review_ruleset` by its `rule_id` like a built-in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A custom rule: block any UPDATE on the billing schema that has no WHERE clause.
resource "accessflow_sql_review_rule" "no_unbounded_billing_update" {
  rule_id          = "custom_no_unbounded_billing_update"
  name             = "No unbounded billing updates"
  description      = "Every UPDATE on the billing schema needs a WHERE clause"
  message          = "{statement_type} on {tables} has no WHERE clause"
  category         = "STATEMENT_SAFETY"
  default_severity = "BLOCK"

  condition = jsonencode({
    type = "and"
    children = [
      { type = "query_type", any_of = ["UPDATE"] },
      { type = "referenced_table", globs = ["billing.*"] },
      { type = "has_where", expected = false },
    ]
  })
}

# Configure it in a ruleset by its rule_id, exactly like a built-in rule.
resource "accessflow_sql_review_ruleset" "production" {
  name        = "Production"
  environment = "PRODUCTION"

  rules = [
    { rule_id = accessflow_sql_review_rule.no_unbounded_billing_update.rule_id, severity = "BLOCK" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) `STATEMENT_SAFETY`, `PERFORMANCE`, `SCHEMA_CHANGE`, or `DATA_PROTECTION`.
- `condition` (String) The typed condition tree as a JSON object string (depth ≤ 5, ≤ 20 criteria).
- `default_severity` (String) `OFF`, `WARN`, or `BLOCK` — used wherever a ruleset does not configure the rule.
- `message` (String) Finding message, at most 500 characters. `{tables}`, `{functions}` and `{statement_type}` are substituted per statement.
- `name` (String) Display name, at most 255 characters.
- `rule_id` (String) `custom_` followed by 3–61 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter. Immutable — changing it replaces the rule.

### Optional

- `description` (String) At most 2000 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. A disabled rule leaves evaluation but keeps its ruleset configs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organization_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Custom SQL review rules are imported by their UUID.
terraform import accessflow_sql_review_rule.no_unbounded_billing_update 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
```
